title: Efficient RNA and RNA-protein co-detection in 3D colonoids by whole-mount staining
protocol: Harvest colonoids from Matrigel.
Remove growth media from wells of colonoids in the 24 well plate by vacuum aspiration.
Add 1 mL cold Organoid Harvesting Solution to each well and mechanically dissociate Matrigel by scratching it off the bottom of the well with a P1000 pipette tip.
Shake on orbital shaker (200 rpm for orbital shakers with a radius of 2.5 cm) for 45–60 min at 4°C.
Gently triturate the colonoid suspension in the Organoid Harvesting Solution 10–20 times using a P1000 pipette to completely remove any remaining Matrigel.
Transfer colonoids suspension to 15 mL conical tube.
Add cold DMEM (4°C) to reach a final volume of 10 mL.
Spin at 600 × g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Remove all supernatant.
If Matrigel is not fully de-polymerized, add Organoid Harvesting Solution and repeat previous steps.
Resuspend pellet in 200 μL of 1× PBS and transfer to a 1.5 mL microfuge tube.
Allow colonoids to settle at the bottom of the tube for 15–20 minutes at room temperature (RT).
Gently remove 1× PBS and add 300 μL of 4% PFA/PBS for 30 minutes.
Remove the fixative and rinse colonoids twice in 500 μL of 1× PBS.
Spin for 15–20 seconds using a tabletop microfuge to settle colonoids at the bottom of the tube between each wash.
Optional: Remove 1× PBS and replace with 500 μL of 50% ethanol, gently triturate 5 times, incubate for 5 minutes.
Replace supernatant with 500 μL of 70% ethanol, gently triturate 5 times, incubate for 5 minutes.
Replace supernatant with 500 μL of 100% ethanol, gently triturate 5 times, incubate for 5 minutes.
Replace supernatant with 500 μL of 100% ethanol for storage, gently triturate 5 times, incubate for 10 minutes.
Store tubes at 4°C for use the next day or at -20°C for longer storage.
Cells can be stored for several weeks at -20°C.
Optional: Remove the ethanol and replace with 500 μL of 70% ethanol, gently triturate 5 times, incubate for 2 minutes.
Spin for 15–20 seconds using a microfuge to settle colonoids at the bottom of the tube.
Replace supernatant with 500 μL of 50% ethanol.
Gently trititate the sample 5 times.
Incubate for 2 minutes.
Spin for 15–20 seconds.
Replace supernatant with 500 μL of 1× PBS.
Gently trititate the sample 5 times.
Incubate for 10 minutes.
Remove 1× PBS from the sample.
Add 5 drops of RNAscope hydrogen peroxide solution to the sample.
Gently resuspend colonoids by trititating 5 times.
Incubate for 10 minutes.
Remove RNAscope hydrogen peroxide solution.
Add 500 μL of distilled water to the sample.
Gently triturate colonoids 10 times.
Spin for 15–20 seconds using a microfuge to settle colonoids at the bottom of the tube.
Repeat wash with distilled water and allow colonoids to settle to the bottom of the tube.
Remove distilled water from the sample.
Add 2–4 drops of RNAscope Protease Plus solution.
Gently trititate 5 times.
Incubate for 10 minutes.
Remove RNAScope Protease Plus solution.
Add 500 μL of 1× PBS to the sample.
Gently resuspend and triturate colonoids 10 times.
Spin for 15-20 seconds using a microfuge to settle colonoids at the bottom of the tube.
Repeat wash steps c – d with 1× PBS.
Remove 1× PBS, add 2 drops (100 μL) of target RNAscope probe and gently triturate to resuspend colonoids in probe solution.
Place tube in the HybEZ humidity control tray.
Close tray and insert in HybEZ oven for 2 hours at 40°C.
Remove tube from oven every 30 minutes and gently triturate to resuspend colonoids in probe solution, then place tube back into HybEZ oven.
After 2 hours, remove probe solution, add 500 μL 1× RNAscope wash buffer then gently triturate 10×.
Spin for 15-20 seconds using a microfuge to settle colonoids at the bottom of the tube.
Repeat wash steps e – f with 500 μL 1× RNAscope wash buffer.
Remove wash buffer, add 2–3 drops of Multiplex FL v2 Amp 1, gently triturate 5× to suspend colonoids in solution.
Place tube in the HybEZ humidity control tray.
Close tray and insert in HybEZ oven for 30 minutes at 40°C.
Remove Amp 1 solution, add 500 μL 1× RNAscope wash buffer then gently triturate 10×.
Repeat wash steps d – e with 500 μL 1× RNAscope wash buffer.
Remove wash buffer, add 2–3 drops of Multiplex FL v2 Amp 2, gently triturate 5× to suspend colonoids in solution.
Place tube in the HybEZ humidity control tray.
Close tray and insert in HybEZ oven for 30 min at 40°C.
Remove Amp 2 solution, add 500 μL 1× RNAscope wash buffer then gently triturate 10×.
Spin for 15–20 s using a microfuge to settle colonoids at the bottom of the tube.
Repeat wash steps j – k with 500 μL 1× RNAscope wash buffer.
Remove wash buffer, add 2–3 drops of Multiplex FL v2 Amp 3, gently triturate 5× to suspend colonoids in solution.
Place tube in the HybEZ humidity control tray.
Close tray and insert in HybEZ oven for 15 min at 40°C.
Remove Amp 3 solution, add 500 μL 1× RNAscope wash buffer then gently triturate 10×.
Spin for 15–20 s using a microfuge to settle colonoids at the bottom of the tube.
Repeat wash steps p – q with 500 μL 1× RNAscope wash buffer.
Remove wash buffer, add 2–3 drops of RNAscope Multiplex FL v2 HRP-C1 and gently triturate to resuspend colonoids.
Place tube in the HybEZ humidity control tray.
Close tray and insert in HybEZ oven for 15 min at 40°C.
Remove HRP C1 solution, add 500 μL 1× RNAscope wash buffer then gently triturate 10×.
Spin for 15–20 s using a microfuge to settle colonoids at the bottom of the tube.
Remove wash buffer from the tube.
Add 200 μL fluorophore (Opal 520, Opal 570, or Opal 620 diluted 1:1,000 in TSA buffer).
Gently resuspend colonoids.
Place the tube in the HybEZ humidity control tray.
Close the tray and insert it into the HybEZ oven for 30 min at 40°C.
Remove the supernatant from the tube.
Add 500 μL 1× RNAscope wash buffer to the tube.
Gently triturate the solution 10 times.
Spin the tube for 15–20 s using a microfuge to settle colonoids at the bottom of the tube.
Repeat washing steps with 500 μL 1× RNAscope wash buffer.
Remove the wash buffer from the tube.
Add 2–3 drops of RNAscope Multiplex FL v2 HRP blocker to the tube.
Gently triturate to resuspend colonoids.
Place the tube in the HybEZ humidity control tray.
Close the tray and insert it into the HybEZ oven for 15 min at 40°C.
Remove the HRP blocker from the tube.
Add 500 μL 1× RNAscope wash buffer to the tube.
Gently triturate the solution 10 times.
Spin the tube for 15–20 s using a microfuge to settle colonoids at the bottom of the tube.
Repeat washing steps with 500 μL 1× RNAscope wash buffer.
Remove wash buffer from the tube.
Add 2–3 drops of DAPI (concentration of 0.5 μg/mL) or other nuclear stain to the tube.
Incubate for 5 min.
Add 500 μL 1× RNAscope wash buffer to the tube.
Gently triturate the solution 5 times.
Spin the tube for 15–20 s using a microfuge to settle colonoids at the bottom of the tube.
Repeat washing step with 500 μL 1× RNAscope wash buffer.
Allow colonoids to naturally settle at the bottom of the tube for approximately 20–30 minutes.
Remove all wash buffer from the tube carefully.
Add 40–50 μL of mounting media to the tube.
Gently triturate 5 times to evenly resuspend colonoids in the mounting media.
Carefully pipette up all colonoids in the mounting media solution and transfer them onto a glass slide.
Place a glass coverslip over the mounting media to spread the colonoids uniformly on the slide.
Dry slides overnight in the dark at room temperature.
Store slides at 4°C until imaging.
Prepare the poly-D/L-lysine solution by diluting it 1:10 with distilled water.
Warm the diluted poly-D/L-lysine solution to room temperature before use.
Pipette enough solution to cover the surface of the coverslip or culture surface on the slide.
Create a 1 inch x 1 inch square area for culture using a hydrophobic PAP pen, if coating a slide.
Incubate the coated coverslips or slides for 10 minutes.
Aspirate the poly-D/L-lysine solution and rinse the slides with UltraPure DNase/RNase-free water.
Allow the slides to dry for at least 2 hours or overnight in a laminar flow hood or low-dust environment.
Store lysine-coated slides at 4°C until use.
Harvest colonoids from Matrigel.
Add 200-300 μL of 4% PFA/PBS to the harvested colonoids.
Transfer the entire volume onto the lysine-coated slide.
Fix colonoids onto lysine-coated slides for 1–2 hours at room temperature.
Remove fixative solution and incubate the slide for 10–15 minutes at 37°C to ensure adherence of colonoids to the slide.
Rinse slides twice with 1× PBS for 2 minutes each to remove residual fixative.
Wash slides in wash buffer for 2 minutes on a rocking shaker at low speed.
Perform two washes by removing reagents within the hydrophobic barrier using dust-free lab wipers.
Remove 1× PBS and add 5 drops of RNAscope hydrogen peroxide onto the colonoids.
Incubate with RNAscope hydrogen peroxide for 10 minutes.
Remove RNAscope hydrogen peroxide solution, place slide in a slide staining jar with distilled water.
Repeat wash step using distilled water.
Alternatively, permeabilize cells using 0.5% Triton X-100/PBS for 20 minutes as an alternative to hydrogen peroxide treatment.
Remove distilled water and add 2–4 drops of RNAScope Protease Plus onto the colonoids.
Incubate with RNAScope Protease Plus for 10 minutes.
Remove RNAScope Protease Plus, place slide in a slide staining jar with 1× PBS.
Repeat wash step using 1× PBS.
Proceed with probe hybridization.
Add 2 drops (100 μL) of target RNAscope probe directly onto the colonoids within the hydrophobic barrier.
Place slide in the HybEZ humidity control tray and incubate at 40°C for 2 hours.
Remove probe solution, transfer slide to a slide staining jar, and wash with 1× RNAscope wash buffer.
Repeat wash step with 1× RNAscope wash buffer.
Optionally, if colonoids are fixed onto lysine coated slides, store in 5× saline sodium citrate (SSC) buffer at room temperature overnight before proceeding to the next step.
Remove wash buffer from slide and add 2–3 drops of Multiplex FL v2 Amp 1.
Place slide in the HybEZ humidity control tray and incubate at 40°C for 30 minutes.
Wash slide with 1× RNAscope wash buffer.
Repeat wash step with 1× RNAscope wash buffer.
Remove wash buffer, add 2–3 drops of Multiplex FL v2 Amp 2.
Place slide in the HybEZ humidity control tray and incubate at 40°C for 30 minutes.
Wash slide with 1× RNAscope wash buffer.
Repeat wash step with 1× RNAscope wash buffer.
Remove wash buffer, add 2–3 drops of Multiplex FL v2 Amp 3.
Place slide in the HybEZ humidity control tray and incubate at 40°C for 15 minutes.
Place slide in slide staining jar and wash with 1× RNAscope wash buffer.
Repeat wash step with 1× RNAscope wash buffer.
Remove wash buffer, add 2–3 drops of RNAscope Multiplex FL v2 HRP-C1.
Place slide in the HybEZ humidity control tray.
Close tray and insert in HybEZ oven for 15 min at 40°C.
Place slide in slide staining jar and wash with 1× RNAscope wash buffer.
Repeat wash step with 1× RNAscope wash buffer.
Remove wash buffer, add 200 μL fluorophore (Opal 520, Opal 570, or Opal 620 diluted 1:1,000 in TSA buffer) directly onto the colonoids within the hydrophobic barrier.
Place slide in the HybEZ humidity control tray.
Close tray and insert in HybEZ oven for 30 min at 40°C.
Place slide in slide staining jar and wash with 1× RNAscope wash buffer.
Repeat wash step with 1× RNAscope wash buffer.
Remove wash buffer, add 2–3 drops of RNAscope Multiplex FL v2 HRP blocker.
Place slide in the HybEZ humidity control tray.
Close tray and insert in HybEZ oven for 15 min at 40°C.
Place slide in slide staining jar and wash with 1× RNAscope wash buffer.
Repeat wash step with 1× RNAscope wash buffer.
Remove wash buffer, add 2–3 drops of DAPI (concentration of 0.5 μg/mL).
Place slide in slide staining jar and wash with 1× RNAscope wash buffer.
Mix 1× RNAscope wash buffer with colonoid samples.
Wick all residual wash buffer carefully.
Add 40–50 μL of mounting media within the hydrophobic barrier.
Place a glass coverslip over the mounting media to spread colonoids uniformly on the slide.
Avoid trapping air bubbles during the process.
Dry slides overnight in the dark at room temperature.
Store slides at 4°C until imaging.
Place slides into slide staining jars.
Rinse slides twice using 1× PBS.
Prepare 1× co-detection target retrieval solution by diluting the 10× solution in 70°C distilled water.
Add 1× co-detection target retrieval to colonoids on lysine-coated slides.
Boil the solution at 100°C for 15 minutes in a steamer.
Rinse slides twice with distilled water for 2 minutes at room temperature.
Add primary antibody diluted in co-detection antibody diluent to cover the colonoids, using approximately 200 μL.
Incubate overnight at 4°C in a humidity control chamber.
Place slides into slide staining jars after incubation.
Rinse slides twice in 0.1% PBS-Tween-20 for 2 minutes.
Remove slides from slide staining jars and lay flat.
Add 4% PFA/PBS to colonoids for 30 minutes.
Place slides back into slide staining jars.
Rinse slides in 0.1% PBS-T for 2 minutes.
Repeat wash step twice with 0.1% PBS-T.
Add 3–5 drops of RNAscope protease plus to completely cover colonoids.
Place slides in prewarmed HybEZ humidity control tray and incubate for 30 min at 40°C.
Rinse slides 3–5 times with distilled water at room temperature.
Incubate slides for 30 min covered and away from light after adding fluorophore-conjugated secondary antibody diluted in co-detection antibody diluent to completely cover colonoids.
Rinse slides twice with 0.1% PBS-T for 2 min with gentle agitation.
Incubate slides for 5 min after adding 2–3 drops of DAPI or other nuclear stain.
Rinse slides twice with 1× PBS.
Wick residual buffer from slides using lint-free wipes.
Add 40–50 μL of mounting media to the slide.
Place a glass coverslip over the mounting media on the slide carefully.
Dry slides overnight in the dark at room temperature.
Store slides at 4°C until imaging.
